subject: BetaTech evaluation: compliance roadmap & close timeline
messages:
From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@betatech.com, Maya Singh <maya.singh@betatech.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Olga — thanks again for the demo last week. BetaTech is excited to run a short evaluation of Redwood for our customer-facing assistant. Before we kick off the POC, procurement and security need a clear MAP focused on compliance gates so we can get to contract review fast.

Can you share a proposed mutual action plan with target dates for: SIG/CAIQ completion, SOC 2 evidence review, DPA execution, data retention/segregation details, and the POC evaluation window? Procurement is hoping to close by mid-May if we can meet their checklist.

Attach anything that helps (questionnaires, SOC report highlights). Also please point us to where DPA redlines should be uploaded.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Jacobs
Sr. PM, BetaTech
ben.jacobs@betatech.com

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Ben — great to hear (and glad the demo landed). I put together an initial MAP and attached the working spreadsheet so we can iterate. High-level proposal below (we can compress if BetaTech needs a faster cadence):

- Week 0 (this week): NDA / mutual access; Redwood shares SOC 2 summary + SIG template. (attached: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-2025-summary.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-questionnaire-v1.xlsx)
- Week 1: BetaTech completes SIG baseline answers; Redwood provides clarifying notes and any missing control evidence.
- Week 2: SOC 2 artifact review (Redwood provides summary and auditor contact if needed); security deep-dive call with Karthik.
- Week 3: DPA negotiation & redline — we accept uploaded DocuSign or shared Drive redlines; Redwood legal (Marissa) will triage. (attached: DPA-redline-BetaTech.docx)
- Weeks 2–4: POC evaluation (2 week hands-on window + 1 week buffer for issues).
- Target: Procurement sign-off and order by 2026-05-15.

Key notes on data retention & segregation:
- Default logs and KV cache retention: 30 days for request metadata; customers can request shorter retention via account settings or the Private deployment option.
- For hosted API: we offer contractual options to restrict data retention and enable customer-managed keys for sensitive workloads.
- We will provide a data flow diagram and mappings in the Drive folder.

Next steps — can BetaTech confirm the target close date and whether you need SOC 2 full report (redacted is usually sufficient) or just the auditor letter + controls mapping? If you want to accelerate, we can front-load the security call this week.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Proposed-MAP-timeline.xlsx]

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@betatech.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>
Cc: security@betatech.com
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Thanks — quick clarifying Qs: 
1) SOC 2: we need either the full Type II (last 12 months) or a SOC-2+readiness with auditor contact. Is the redacted report sufficient for our InfoSec team?
2) DPA: we usually push data residency and deletion SLA into the DPA. Does Redwood offer a contractual deletion SLA for hosted customers?
3) SIG: will your team complete any sections internally (e.g., system architecture) or do you expect us to do the full questionnaire?

If we can get answers by EOD Tuesday (4/28) we can keep to the mid-May close.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Security Operations, BetaTech
security@betatech.com

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@betatech.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Maya — quick answers below, happy to jump on a deep-dive call.

1) SOC 2: a redacted Type II report plus the auditor contact and our controls mapping is our standard initial deliverable and is acceptable to most customers. If you require the full report under NDA, we can accommodate — please flag and we'll scope it.

2) Deletion SLA: for hosted customers we offer a contractual deletion commitment:
   - "Best-effort" deletion within 72 hours for session artifacts;
   - Full KV/cache purge within 7 days on request;
   - Customers with Dedicated or Private deployments get explicit residency and deletion windows as part of the contract.
   We can include a deletion SLA clause in the DPA; Marissa will work with you on exact language.

3) SIG/CAIQ: we'll pre-fill sections that are purely vendor-provided (architectural diagrams, control ownership, encryption-at-rest details). We ask BetaTech to complete environment-specific controls (e.g., access provisioning if you plan to integrate via SSO). That cuts completion time by ~40%.

Proposed immediate schedule: security deep-dive call on Wed 2026-04-29 10:00 PT (30–45 min) — I can present the runtime architecture, isolation controls, and KV cache behavior. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Technical note on retention: request/response content is treated as customer data. For hosted API customers opting for reduced retention, we can provide a configuration and contractual addendum; it is irreversible once enabled.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_SOC2-TypeII-2025-summary.pdf]

From: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@betatech.com>, security@betatech.com
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Thanks — that all helps. 29th at 10:00 PT works for the security call. We'll plan the SIG baseline answers this week (Maya will lead) and upload to your Drive folder. For the DPA, Procurement prefers to post redlines in the DocuSign link you provided; legal will aim to have an initial redline by next Monday (5/4).

One ask from procurement: is there a standard procurement playbook or SOW example you can share so we can prepare internal approvals? If you can add it to the Drive folder that'd speed things.

Targeting the 2026-05-15 procurement sign-off still — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ben

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@betatech.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BetaTech evaluation kickoff — compliance deliverables and timeline

Ben / Team — looping in on DPA redlines. We prefer DocuSign for the initial redline (your link is fine). Two quick notes: 

- We will accept standard commercial redlines for deletion/residency but require business justification for any clause that would limit our ability to provide hosted service (e.g., prohibit cross-region failover).
- I'll add a Procurement playbook and a sample SOW to the Drive folder by EOD Friday.

If there are specific non-standard asks please flag them early so we can triage with legal. Looking forward to the call tomorrow.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[attachment: DPA-redline-BetaTech.docx]
